think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range. 2) Check whether any particular numeric value (e.g., 0, -1) changes the knob’s semantics qualitatively (e.g., disables/enables a different mode) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such a value exists, mark it as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob.
